مَجْهُولٌ [Unknown]. You say, رَكِبْتُ المَفَازَةٌ عَلَى مَجْهُولِهَا [I ventured upon traversing the desert notwithstanding its unknown character]. (S, TA.) ―
-b2- [A man of unknown origin. A book of unknown authorship. ―
-b3- In grammar, The passive voice.] ―
-b4- نَاقَةٌ مَجْهُولَةٌ (tropical:) A she-camel that has never been milked: or that has no brand upon her: (K, TA:) and (tropical:) a she-camel that has never conceived. (Z, TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
